label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value rememberMeKey = Integer.toString(new java.util.Random().nextInt()), which uses insecure pseudo-random number generator for session token generation; java.util.Random is predictable and unsuitable for security-sensitive material like remember-me cookies. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided param from request.getParameterValues('BenchmarkTest02504') passed through doSomething() and concatenated into response.getWriter().println() without HTML encoding; attacker-controlled input reaches the HTML response body. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Insecure Randomness: new java.util.Random().nextInt() used to generate rememberMeKey for session cookie
XSS Sink: User input (param) concatenated into response.getWriter().println() without HTML encoding
